result.title: TaoMate-HD: Progressive-Resolution Autoregressive Audio-Video Generation
result.summary: Streaming digital humans produce detailed video while continuing speech as new text arrives. High-resolution denoising is costly, and text updates can cause repeated or interrupted speech. We present TaoMate-HD, an autoregressive model for high-resolution audio-video streaming. For each short segment, or chunk, two denoising steps establish coarse video structure at low resolution. A final step refines the video to high resolution, with audio generated throughout the same trajectory. Each stage passes its audiovisual predictions to the same stage of the next chunk as history. Across text updates, the model retains this history to infer what has already been spoken. Continuation training utilizes asymmetric text conditioning, with separate text windows for generation and distillation. Experiments show a 1.6x speedup over direct high-resolution generation with the same model and hardware. Optimized stage-parallel deployment provides a further 1.9x overall speedup over serial progressive generation. Our continuation training reduces character error rate by 11.18 percentage points relative to the baseline. The model also supports hour-long audiovisual generation. Our project page is https://taoliveaigc.github.io/TaoMate-HD.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 TaoMate-HD，一种高分辨率音视频流式生成的自回归模型：每个 chunk 先用两步低分辨率去噪建立粗略视频结构，再一步精修到高分辨率，音频沿同一轨迹生成，并将各阶段预测作为下一 chunk 的历史；配合非对称文本窗口的续写训练，实现约 1.6 倍加速并降低字错率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其跨 chunk 传递的分阶段预测历史与由粗到细的分级计算，可为 LVR 的推理状态更新与计算分配提供对照线索；但研究目标是音视频生成，与视觉推理仅间接相关，值得核查。
